bio: Rowhill Grange is a charming 18th century country house hotel, surrounded by acres of gorgeous gardens, tended grounds and a picturesque lake. This hotel is perfectly placed to enjoy Afternoon Tea either out on the terraces or lawn or in the cooler months in one of the cosy lounges.  From delicious sandwiches on freshly baked bread to decadent macarons fresh from the pastry chefs, Afternoon Tea at Rowhill Grange is the ultimate quintessentially British experience. Why not add a glass of Laurent Perrier Champagne? What could be more decadent?  Afternoon Tea is priced from £34pp Monday - Friday and £37pp Saturday - Sunday.
